title: Concept: Operating-system command executed from an R string in r — review required
description: In r, system is invoked. R scripts frequently process filenames and identifiers from CSV input, so the command string can contain text the author never typed; the shell interprets it. system2 with separate arguments is the safer form and does not require a shell.
applicability: r analysis pipelines and Shiny services.
risk: Command execution with the R process identity; HIGH severity.
